questions.question: Use the flow diagram hours, times 15, plus 50, cost to complete the table for 1, 2, 3 and 4 hours.
A family paid R350 for the jumping castle. Work backwards to find the number of hours, and check your answer.
Show that the rule multiply the position by 8 and subtract 1 is equivalent to the pattern 7, 15, 23, 31.
questions.expected_answer: Position 1: 8 − 1 = 7. Position 2: 16 − 1 = 15. Position 3: 24 − 1 = 23. Position 4: 32 − 1 = 31. Every position gives the same term, so they are equivalent.
